descFull: AI companion for Paperless-ngx: automatically titles, tags and files your documents, reads bad scans with local OCR (PaddleOCR, CPU/GPU) and answers questions about your whole archive with cited sources. Works with OpenAI, Claude, Ollama (fully local), Azure and any OpenAI-compatible API.
